in.other_title: Transfer a formal bound to the open LLM oversight event
in.rationale: Applying the checked theorem requires evidence for all of its premises.

rules: Every record and link keeps its recorded state; most are PROPOSED (AI-drafted, unreviewed). Say so when you use them.
A link is a recorded connection, not a verified relationship. An empty path_eligibility means the link may not be chained to carry a result into another setting.
Cite the paper and the PDF page in the record's sources, and check the paper before relying on a claim.
Counts are indexed records, not distinct ideas or papers. Absence of a record is a gap in the atlas, not evidence that nothing exists.
state_meaning: A machine check (for example a Lean proof check) passed for the stated scope only; meaning is not reviewed.
text: On an explicit finite joint coupling, if ideal true-event mass is at most b, first-stage mismatch mass at most ε₁, second-stage mismatch mass on ideal continuations at most ε₂, and observed-event mismatch mass at most η, then observed true-event mass is at most b+ε₁+ε₂+η. It constructs no coupling and supplies no real-system error budget.
title: Finite two-stage event-transfer bound
